title: Magnetic Laplacian — 3-node directed example
source: Chi, Gao & Wang (2024), arXiv 2410.22706, eqs. 6-9; Shubin (1994) magnetic Laplacian

derivation.step_1: W = [[0,1,0],[0,0,0],[0,0,0]]: single directed edge 0->1 with weight 1
derivation.step_7: Phase[i,j] = exp(i * 2*pi*q * Theta[i,j]). With q=0.25: Phase[0,1] = exp(i*pi/2) = i, Phase[1,0] = exp(-i*pi/2) = -i
derivation.step_11: Eigenvalues: det(L - lam*I) for 2x2 block [[1-lam, -i],[i, 1-lam]] gives (1-lam)^2 - 1 = 0 -> lam = 0 or 2. Plus lam=1 from isolated node 2.

q_zero_case.description: When q=0, magnetic Laplacian reduces to standard symmetric normalized Laplacian on W_s
